document: Gate G3-C.0 tasks 9-10: three-phase execution/budget plan (not executed) and unified engineering checks

gold_authority.note: Single-annotator gold carried unchanged from Gate 3-A.1; no second independent human adjudicator has been obtained as of Gate G3-C.0. All Gate 3-C endpoint definitions are pre-registered against the FUTURE adjudicated gold; PROVISIONAL-gold re-analyses are secondary only. The AI preparing this design is NOT an independent human annotator or arbiter.

budget_protection: pre-call worst-case bound computed from token caps BEFORE the HTTP call (the regression test that would have caught the CompositeGuard None bug); guard returns a float and is unit-tested for None/NaN
mock gate and zero-API local live gate must pass before any paid batch; cumulative cost is persisted per row and re-checked on resume (no double-spend across restarts)
integrity_persistence: raw-first persistence (raw response + tool trace written before parsing), row-level sha256, resume idempotency, post-hoc analyzer hash match — the same discipline as G3-B.3
missing_reason_or_unparseable: a missing/empty reason or unparseable verdict is a PRE-DEFINED outcome: verdict=UNPARSEABLE is logged and retained (not retried away); for P1 it counts as non-commitment/NEED; for P2 it is failure-to-evaluate with a complete-case sensitivity bound
no post-hoc exclusion of such rows from the frozen analysis
model_version_drift: record expected_model_id and model_served for EVERY cell; mismatch flags the row and fails the batch
pin provider model snapshot/date where supported; log the raw version field; a version change mid-phase forces a pause and a fresh calibration cell
no silent alias resolution (e.g. mini -> a newer revision)
prompt_length: capture tokens_in per cell; fail if a prompt exceeds a pre-set fraction of the context (guard basis p90 observed ~22975.0 tokens); log truncation indicators
rendered prompts are persisted raw-first and byte-hashed so prompt changes across phases are detectable
randomness: record temperature/seed/top_p per call; use a fixed pre-registered seed schedule; any repeat/replicate cells average WITHIN issue (never inflate n)
log raw_model_calls and retries; retries must reuse the seed policy and are audited, never silently dropped
tool_capability: validate the tool schema is accepted before the batch; count HTTP 4xx/5xx and tool-schema errors; any new tool error type halts the phase
assert 403 (never 200) for f2p/p2p/p2p_baseline under strict and that the body is never read
synthetic canary cells confirm linkage/freshness/coverage still return the designed structural fields under projection v2
truncation: set and record max_tokens; detect finish_reason=length / cut-off JSON; truncated verdicts are flagged and treated like UNPARSEABLE, with the raw tail retained

phases.note: validates projection v2, the non-interference gate, packets, drift checks and budget guard on a tiny real sample; gates release of batch 1
phases.phase: P0 quality pilot (mock + zero-API live gate + small real)

phases.note: the P2-defining cohort; P1 measured on the tier-D arms; orthogonal static/active cells collected for P1a
phases.phase: B1 first external validation (>=20 new independent REJECT issues)

phases.note: ACCEPT/need controls and additional repos; only after B1 quality review and a written (separately approved) release

planning_assumptions.mean_cell_cost_source: frozen G3-B.3 REAL live rows (100 cells), not mock
planning_assumptions.price_drift_warning: provider list prices and model versions can change; recompute mean/max from the pilot before B1 and re-approve caps; estimates here are planning figures, not commitments

stopping_rules: HARD pre-call budget guard (the repaired CompositeGuard pattern): float(bound) is evaluated before any network call; no call that could breach the phase cap is issued; per-model sub-caps too.
stop the phase if the cumulative run-rate projects > hard cap with the next batch; require a new written approval to continue.
stop and freeze on any protocol-capability drift: silent response_format downgrade, wire fallback, unexpected model id served, or tool-schema rejection.
stop if the zero-API live gate / preflight / non-interference scan (tier1>0 or tier2>0) fails.
abort-and-investigate trigger (harm-only interim look, at most once): e.g. a model commits unsupported ACCEPT on essentially every REJECT issue in B1; never stop to cherry-pick a favourable result.
no expansion beyond the frozen issue/projection list without a new separate written approval (G3-C.2); G3-C.0 executes none of this.
